items.title: File Widerspruch against the benefit amount
items.quote: Einen Widerspruch reichen Sie bitte binnen Monatsfrist nach Bekanntgabe ein, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Musterhöhe – Jugendamt, Kreishausstraße 1, 61169 Beispielberg.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 15.09.2025 (Monday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date given, so posting day = 15.09.2025. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (social-law body), a letter posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days: 15.09.(day0)→16.09→17.09→18.09→19.09.2025 = delivery day (Friday). For non-tax authorities the delivery day itself is not moved even onto a weekend/holiday, but here 19.09.2025 is a weekday anyway. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day with the same number one month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 19.10.2025. That date is a Sunday, so under § 64 Abs. 3 SGG the period end moves to the next working day: Monday 20.10.2025.

items.title: Notify Jugendamt of changes affecting the benefit (child moving out, marriage, other parent paying maintenance)
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte unverzüglich mit, wenn Mila nicht mehr bei Ihnen lebt, wenn Sie heiraten oder wenn der andere Elternteil Unterhalt zahlt.
items.computation: The letter requires notification 'unverzüglich' (without undue delay) upon occurrence of any of the listed events, but sets no fixed calendar date and the trigger events (if any) have not occurred as of the letter's issue; therefore no fixed due date can be computed — the obligation is ongoing and event-triggered.
